title: Gizli Özne
author: Nihan Kaya
description: The Hidden Subject is the compelling story of two women, Bihter and Revnâ, as they confront their pasts and come to terms with their identities. The novel takes readers on a gripping journey, delving deeply into the inner worlds of its protagonists. Bihter grows up in a family deprived of love and affection, while Revnâ struggles with the pain of her mother’s death. These traumas leave lasting marks on their adult lives, complicating their search for identity. The Hidden Subject presents Bihter and Revnâ’s stories from two distinct perspectives, offering readers a broader understanding of their experiences.
